speaker: Doctor
text: I need to understand the progression of your symptoms. Has the rash ever appeared in other locations, such as your face or upper back, or is it strictly limited to your hands?

speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Porphyria Cutanea Tarda (PCT). The combination of blistering or scaly rash on sun-exposed areas (face, upper body) and neurological symptoms like tingling in the hands, combined with your work history involving livestock (potential iron overload or toxin exposure), strongly suggests PCT. I will request a urine porphobilinogen and urine porphyrins test to confirm.
